title: The traveller’s prayer
intro: On a journey Allah makes Salah easier: the 4-rak‘ah fards become 2.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah wants ease for you, and He does not want hardship for you. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Baqarah 2:185)</small>

One of the most valuable deeds with Allah is a complete, humble Salah prayed on time. Sometimes life makes it hard to pray in the usual way – and one of those times is when a Muslim is travelling. So Allah has made it easier.

learn.title: Who is a traveller (musafir)?
learn.html: A musafir is a person who leaves the place where they live and travels at least 80 kilometres (about 50 miles) away.

learn.text: ✈️ What is easier for the traveller

items: The fard prayers of 4 rak‘ahs are shortened to 2 rak‘ahs – the fard of Fajr and Maghrib are not shortened.
Witr is prayed in full, without shortening.
The sunnah prayers are not required. If there is free time, the traveller prays them in full, without shortening.

learn.html: When possible, the traveller prays in congregation (jama‘ah). If he joins people who live in that place (residents) and their imam is a resident, he follows the imam without shortening – he prays all 4 rak‘ahs. A traveller should avoid being the imam of residents. But if it happens, he shortens his own prayer to 2 rak‘ahs, and the residents behind him stand up and finish the 3rd and 4th rak‘ah on their own.

learn.text: Praying in a car, bus, train or plane

learn.html: On a journey, a Muslim should plan stops so he can pray each Salah on time, using the ease Allah has given. If he cannot stop, he prays in the vehicle as well as he can: if possible he turns towards the Qiblah and prays sitting, making ruku‘ and sajdah by bowing his head. If it is possible, he prays standing. If he misses a prayer, he makes it up as soon as he can – the way he had to pray it on the journey, with the 4-rak‘ah fards shortened.

learn.title: ✋ Remember!
learn.html: Nafl (extra) prayers may be prayed sitting if standing is difficult for us.

learn.text: How long does the ease last?

learn.html: If the traveller plans to stay in the place he travelled to for up to 15 days, he uses the ease the whole time he is there. If, when he sets off, he plans to stay longer than 15 days, he uses the ease only while he is on the way – when he arrives, the ease stops and he prays in full.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “The deeds most loved by Allah are: praying Salah on time, being good and obedient to parents, and striving in Allah’s way.” (Bukhari)

practice.title: Is he a musafir?
practice.prompt: Who counts as a traveller (musafir)? Tap them, then tap Check.

options.text: Amir drives 300 km to visit his aunt for a week
Lejla flies abroad for a 5-day trip
Hasan goes to the shop 2 km from his house
options.why: A musafir travels at least 80 km from home.

options.text: Sara visits her friend in the next street
options.why: That is not a journey – it is much less than 80 km.

questions.q: How far must a person travel to be a musafir?
How many rak‘ahs of fard does a traveller pray for Dhuhr on his own?
A traveller joins a resident imam for Dhuhr. How many rak‘ahs does he pray?
options: 4 – he follows the imam without shortening

questions.q: A traveller leads residents in Isha. What do the residents do after his salam?
options: Stand up and finish the 3rd and 4th rak‘ah on their own

questions.q: If a traveller can’t stand in a plane, how does he pray?
options: Sitting, making ruku‘ and sajdah by bowing his head
He does not pray at all

questions.q: Ali sets off planning to stay 20 days in another city. When does he use the ease?

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 💬 Who is a musafir? What is made easier for a traveller? How do you pray in a vehicle?
📋 A traveller stops at a mosque where the people are praying Dhuhr, and joins them behind the local imam. Write how he will pray Dhuhr.

🗺️ Imagine you are planning a trip to another city. Use a map app to find how many kilometres it is from where you live, and how many days you plan to stay. Are you a musafir? Which kinds of ease do you have in your Salah?

🤔 Choose one: How should a traveller act if residents ask him to be their imam? Which ease does a traveller have if he left after Fajr planning to stay 10 days with a friend? And if he plans to stay longer than 15 days?
